items.title: Vertical Accuracy Statement
items.statement: All surveying and mapping products with elevation data shall state the datum and a description of the control upon which the surveying and mapping products are based. The data shall be supported with documentation describing the vertical accuracy and the methodology used to determine accuracy. Elevation data may be obtained on an assumed datum provided the base elevation of the assumed datum is obviously different than a publicly published datum and clearly noted.

items.title: Horizontal Accuracy Statement
items.statement: All surveying and mapping products expressing or displaying mapped features shall state the datum and a detailed description of the control upon which the surveying and mapping products are based. The data shall be supported with documentation describing the horizontal accuracy and the methodology used to determine accuracy. Mapped features may be obtained on an assumed datum provided the numerical basis of the datum is obviously different than a publicly published datum.

items.title: Assumed Datum Statement
items.statement: If data is collected on an assumed datum, then adequate control points shall be established and communicated in the surveying and mapping product in order that the survey may be independently reproduced and verified.

items.title: Date of Measurement
items.statement: Measurement and computation records shall be dated as of the date of acquisition and must contain sufficient data to substantiate the surveying and mapping products.

items.title: Statement of Purpose
items.statement: Each survey map and report shall state the type and/or purpose of the survey it depicts.

items.title: Name of Responsible Surveyor / Company
items.statement: All survey maps and reports must bear the name, certificate of authorization number, and street and mailing address of the business entity issuing the map and report, along with the name and license number of the surveyor and mapper in responsible charge. The name, license number, and street and mailing address of a surveyor and mapper practicing independent of any business entity must be shown on each survey map and report.

items.title: Survey Date
items.statement: All survey maps must reflect a survey date, which is the last date of data acquisition. When the graphics of a map are revised, but the survey date stays the same, the map must list dates for all revisions.

items.title: Signature and Seal Statement
items.statement: The survey map and report and the copies of the survey map and report, except those with electronic signature and electronic seal, must contain a statement indicating that the survey map and report or the copies thereof are not valid without the original signature and seal of a Florida licensed surveyor and mapper.

items.title: Abbreviations
items.statement: Abbreviations related to surveying matters shall be defined on the work product.

items.title: Basis of Bearing Declaration
items.statement: A reference to all bearings shown on a survey map or report must be clearly stated, i.e., whether to "True North"; "Grid North as established by the NOS"; "Assumed North based on a bearing for a well defined line, such as the center line of a road or right of way, etc."; "a Deed Call for a particular line"; or "the bearing of a particular line shown upon a plat." References to Magnetic North should be avoided except in the cases where a comparison is necessitated by a Deed Call. In all cases, the bearings used shall be referenced to some well-established and monumented line.

items.title: Scale and Compass
items.statement: A designated "north arrow" and either a stated scale or graphic scale of the map shall be prominently shown upon the survey map.

items.title: Clarity of Survey
items.statement: The responsibility for all mapped features must be clearly stated on any map or report signed by a Florida licensed surveyor and mapper. When mapped features surveyed by the signing surveyor and mapper have been integrated with mapped features surveyed by others, then the map or report shall clearly state the individual primarily responsible for the map or report.

items.title: Monumentation of Boundary Corners
items.statement: Monuments shall be set or held as marking the corners after a well-reasoned analysis by the licensee.

items.title: Required Survey Purpose Statement
items.statement: All boundary surveys shall result in a map (hardcopy and/or digital) and it shall be stated on the map that the survey is a "Boundary Survey."

items.title: Boundary Discrepancy Statement
items.statement: Any discrepancies between the survey map and the real property description shall be shown.

items.title: Survey Data Required
items.statement: Survey data shall be shown to positively describe the boundaries of the surveyed property. For portions of the property bounded by an irregular line, distances and directions to the irregular boundary shall be shown with as much certainty as can be determined or as "more or less," if variable.

items.title: Platted Lot Requirements
items.statement: Surveys of all or part of a lot(s) which is part of a recorded subdivision shall show the lot(s) and block numbers or other designations, including those of adjoining lots.

items.title: Metes and Bounds Requirements
items.statement: Surveys of parcels described by metes and bounds shall show all information called for in the property description, including point of commencement, course bearings and distances, and point of beginning.

items.title: Boundary Difference Note
items.statement: When the results of the survey differ significantly from the record, or if a fundamental decision related to the boundary resolution is not clearly reflected on the plat or map, the surveyor shall explain this information with notes on the face of the plat or map.

items.title: Water Boundaries Required Statements
items.statement: Surveys of parcels with water boundaries shall describe the feature located including, top of bank, edge of water, mean high water line, ordinary high water line and the method used to locate the water boundary. Water boundaries may be located in their approximate position as long as this is adequately depicted and explained with notes on the face of the plat or map.

items.title: Monuments Information Required
items.statement: All monuments, found or placed, must be described on the survey map. The corner descriptions shall state the size, material, and cap identification of the monument as well as whether the monument was found or set. Offset monuments shall be noted as such on the survey map along with the offset distance to the true corner. Building corners are acceptable as monuments so long as use of the building corners as monumentation is clearly noted on the map.

items.title: Irregular Boundary Meander Lines
items.statement: For irregular boundaries such as a water body or maintained right of way, a dimensioned meander or survey closure line shall be used and monuments shall be set at the meander or survey closure line's terminus points on real property boundary lines.

items.title: Ownership Lines
items.statement: Open and notorious evidence of boundary lines, such as fences, walls, buildings, monuments or otherwise, shall be shown upon the map, together with dimensions sufficient to show their relationship to the boundary line(s).

items.title: Apparent Access Points
items.statement: All apparent physical use onto or from adjoining property must be indicated, with the extent of such use shown or noted upon the map.

items.title: Underground Footings Disclaimer
items.statement: In all cases where foundations may violate deed or easement lines and are beneath the surface, failure to determine their location shall be noted upon the map or report.

items.title: Rights-of-Way Shown
items.statement: All recorded public and private rights-of-way shown on applicable recorded plats adjoining or across the land being surveyed shall be located and shown upon the map.

items.title: Easements Shown
items.statement: Easements shown on applicable record plats or open and notorious evidence of easements or rights-of-way on or across the land being surveyed shall be located and shown upon the map.

items.title: Closed Streets / Rights-of-Way
items.statement: When streets or street rights-of-way abutting the land surveyed are physically closed to travel, a note to this effect shall be shown upon the map.

items.title: Cemeteries Shown
items.statement: Human cemeteries and burial grounds located within the premises shall be located and shown upon the map when open and notorious, or when knowledge of their existence and location is furnished to the surveyor and mapper.

items.title: Fixed Improvements Located
items.statement: Location of fixed improvements pertinent to the survey shall be graphically shown upon the map and their positions shall be dimensioned in reference to the boundaries, either directly or by offset lines.

items.title: Fixed Improvements Not Located Disclaimer
items.statement: When fixed improvements are not located or do not exist, a note to this effect shall be shown upon the map.
